title: Reef-Tank Parameter Stability
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reeftank:param
| stats latest(temp_c) as temp, latest(ph) as ph, latest(salinity_ppt) as salinity
| eval temp_ok=if(temp>=25 AND temp<=27,"good","check"), ph_ok=if(ph>=7.9 AND ph<=8.4,"good","check"), sal_ok=if(salinity>=34 AND salinity<=36,"good","check")
description: Checks the core reef parameters, temperature, pH, and salinity, stay inside the narrow bands corals need to thrive.
value: Reef inhabitants are unforgiving of swings; a continuous stability check protects a living system that took months to build.
implementation: Ingest controller parameters into `index=personal`; alert when temperature, pH, or salinity leaves its safe band.
visualization: Status panel of temperature, pH, and salinity with safe bands.
grandmaExplanation: It checks the water in a reef tank stays just right for the corals, watching temperature, acidity, and saltiness.
